briefTitle: Safety and Preliminary Efficacy of Pumitamig (BNT327), an Investigational Therapy for Patients With Non-small Cell Lung Cancer in Combination With Chemotherapy as First-line or Second-line Treatment

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have received minimum two cycles of immunotherapy in first-line treatment to be eligible to this study. Only one prior line of immunotherapy containing regimen is allowed in an advanced/metastatic setting. If participant had received adjuvant immunotherapy the disease-free interval (after the last dose of adjuvant immunotherapy) should be at least 6 months.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Detailed prior immunotherapy cycle counts and disease-free intervals are complex and cannot be fully expressed in a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Historical PD-L1 results must be available.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires availability of historical results without specifying a numerical PD-L1 minimum or maximum percentage cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least one measurable lesion as the targeted lesion based on RECIST v1.1. Tumor lesions situated in a previously irradiated area are considered measurable if progression has been documented after irradiation. Historical images within 28 days of the screening visit may be accepted as a screening image if deemed acceptable in the opinion of the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease assessment by RECIST v1.1 is subjective imaging criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must provide tumor tissue samples obtained ≤18 months prior to enrollment. For the additional cohort in Part 2, both baseline (freshly obtained) and on-treatment tumor biopsy samples are required.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or requirement to undergo biopsies and provide specific tissue samples is a procedural criterion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a known or suspected hypersensitivity to the study treatments, their metabolites or formulation of excipients including polysorbate 80 (see Docetaxel label).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity is a clinical assessment and not a typed laboratory or protocol check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received systemic corticosteroids (at a dosage greater than 10 mg/day of prednisone or an equivalent dose of other corticosteroids) within 7 days prior to the initiation of study treatment (except for docetaxel premedication).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Corticosteroid washout with equivalent dosing rules is complex and combines a medication exclusion with timing windows.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have a serious or non-healing wound, or (incompletely healed) bone fracture. This includes history (within 6 months prior to study entry) or risk of abdominal fistula, tracheoesophageal fistula, gastrointestinal perforation, or intra abdominal abscess or esophageal and gastric varices, or acute gastrointestinal bleeding.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex medical history and risk assessments are subjective and not represented by standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with significant risk of hemorrhage as defined in the protocol.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Risk of hemorrhage is investigator-dependent and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have superior vena cava syndrome or symptoms of spinal cord compression.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Specific clinical syndrome exclusions are not captured by standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Stage IV NSCLC that has documented radiographic progression on one or after one prior line of systemic treatment (programmed death-1 [PD-1]/ programmed death ligand-1 [PD-L1] inhibitor and platinum-based chemotherapy concomitantly) in advanced/metastatic setting per the American Joint Committee on Cancer staging system, 9th edition.
